change: Use reusable bounded pinned windows for CUDA host-state IO while retaining pageable cached-state vectors and the same serialized bytes.

pinned_workspace.allocation: Lazy; reused across snapshots; one attempt per backend until the pool is cleared.
pinned_workspace.download: Queue device-to-pinned chunks, synchronize, then memcpy to pageable destinations in global serialization order.
pinned_workspace.upload: Memcpy pageable source to stable pinned chunks before queuing device writes; synchronize before reuse.
pinned_workspace.lifetime: Released after context synchronization and before scheduler/backend teardown.
pinned_workspace.allocation_failure: Original synchronous IO, including detection of the CUDA allocator's pageable fallback.

checks: deferred fake-CUDA copies require synchronization before host completion
one workspace allocation is reused across multiple snapshots
per-backend capacity is enforced, clamped at 64 MiB, and released by pool clear
multi-window downloads and uploads preserve bytes without early staging reuse
upload inputs can be modified after queueing without altering captured bytes
cross-device overlapping host destinations retain global serialization order
download-to-upload direction changes make host data available before reuse
download host/device aliases and upload read-after-write aliases force barriers
cross-device writes to shared storage preserve ordering
more than 256 copy records flush safely without unbounded metadata
missing, failed and pageable-fallback host allocation retain synchronous behavior without per-tensor retries
CPU, Metal, split, host and unmatched buffers retain original accessors
view offsets, exception unwinding, diagnostic opt-out and zero-size transfers retain behavior
tiny CPU model snapshots are byte-identical and post-restore logits match across modes
truncated CPU model restore fails and a subsequent valid restore recovers
managed_patch_roundtrip: applies after the existing conversation-only patch
repeated application is idempotent with two SHA metadata rows
reverse removal restores tracked source and removes the new header and metadata
custom revisions skip managed patches and clear stale metadata
validation.independent_read_only_review: No concrete correctness defect found in staging lifetime, ordering, fallback or teardown.

limits: No GPU performance or output-quality claim is established by these CPU/fake-backend tests; physical GPU qualification is performed separately.
No weights, KV precision, context limits, sampling or numerical kernels changed.
No production container or deployment was changed by this agent.
